{{Top|leg}}
The '''Coruscant Security Alert''' was a notice distributed by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It would allow Coruscant Security to inform the public of threats and offer [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] for the capture of various criminals. In one case, a bounty was offered for the [[Fondor Five]], a criminal gang composed of [[Basher]], [[Burnout (criminal)|Burnout]], [[Chopper (criminal)|Chopper]], [[Gutshot]], and [[Longeye]].

==Full text==
{{ExcerptIU|CORUSCANT SECURITY ALERT<br />

''Criminal gang "The Fondor Five" confirmed active in Old Galactic Market sector. Last seen entering Fartrader Lounge. All five gang members carry death sentences and substanital bounties from numerous violent felony convictions.''<br />

''Bounty payment to be rendered contingent upon substantive proof of gang members' final status.''<br />

''CITIZENS STRONGLY DISCOURAGED FROM PURSUING BOUNTY &ndash; SUSPECTS CONSIDERED ARMED AND EXTREMELY DANGEROUS!''
|attrib=The alert}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security Alert appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It can be accessed from a computer terminal in the Old Galactic Market. The player can choose to either accept or decline the bounty offered for the capture of the gang.
